_comment: Bank-level POS reporting collected by the Kosovo Banking Association.
PROVENANCE. Unlike every other input in this project, this one was not
downloaded from a publisher and hashed. It was supplied by the project owner
as an aggregate extract. There is no source file, no SHA-256 and no download
date to cite, and the report says so rather than implying an official
download. Only bank totals appear here: no merchant, terminal or
AMOUNT UNIT. The extract prints amounts without a unit. Thousands of euro is
the only reading that survives arithmetic: it puts the average payment at
EUR 23.98, against EUR 22.86 to EUR 28.12 across the three BQK series over
comparable spans. Euro units would give EUR 0.02 a payment, millions would
PERIOD. The extract carries no period label, and none is invented.

source.publication: Kosovo Banking Association — bank reporting, POS transactions
source.supplied_by: Project owner, as an aggregate extract
source.period_note: No period label in the extract. The terminal count sits between the BQK monthly stock for March 2026 (31,187) and April 2026 (32,121), and the transaction count is within 0.2% of BQK Table 15 domestic for the twelve months to March 2026. The value for that same window is 6% lower. No single BQK window fits all four rows, so no period is asserted.

universe.name: POS Transactions — KBA bank reporting
universe.perspective: Acquiring, reported by the acquiring bank
universe.note: A fourth POS universe. It matches none of the three BQK series, so it is never mixed with them: every figure derived from it has a KBA numerator and a KBA denominator.

notes.blank_banks: BPB and PRB report no figure. That is absent, not zero, and they are excluded from every ratio rather than entered as nil.
notes.merchants: Merchant counts are per acquiring bank, so a merchant accepting through two banks is counted by each. The 15,348 total is acquiring relationships, not distinct merchants — it exceeds the highest unduplicated BQK monthly merchant count of 14,049. Terminals do not have this problem: a terminal has one acquirer.
notes.codes: Bank codes are reproduced exactly as the extract prints them. No expansion to full legal names is attempted.
